pr_title: Removes Legacy JSON Cloud Protocol Support In Agent
pr_body:
##### Summary
Remove old JSON based cloud protocol. Support has already been removed on Cloud side and therefore it is not needed in agent anymore.

This allows us also to do further code simplification.

closes #13097
